reason: Both propose the same plausible Mo-to-Nb substitution, but B is more decisively testable because it specifies a substitution series, controlled phase state, statistical plasticity improvement, and a quantitative strength-retention criterion. Its mechanistic rationale is somewhat simplified and some cited evidence is tangential, but the core Nb-for-ductility/Mo-for-strength trade-off is supported and more operationally framed than in A.
